_comment: Declared feature inventory for PROGRESS.md. Weights are relative effort, not time. Update 'status' when a plan ships a feature; everything else is derived. Statuses: done | partial | blocked | todo. Items with status todo/blocked are intentionally counted in the denominator, so the percentage reflects the product as now intended rather than as first declared.

features.name: Record the full screen
features.note: 60 fps target, ~54 delivered, stable intervals

features.name: Record a specific window
features.note: 58.7 fps on an animated window; picker with thumbnails

features.name: Record a selected region
features.note: Drag to select; cropped with the breakout box (lower jitter and CPU than canvas)

features.name: Record with no audio
features.note: Current behaviour — no audio track is written at all

features.name: Record system audio
features.note: WASAPI loopback, persisted, reports the track that actually arrived

features.name: Record microphone
features.note: Picker with Windows default; falls back if the chosen device is gone

features.name: Record system + mic together
features.note: Web Audio mix into one track, per-source gain at 1.0

features.name: Save recordings to disk
features.note: Streamed, atomic .part to rename, collision-safe

features.name: Reveal a recording in Explorer
features.note: A recording or its folder, in Explorer

features.name: Browse recordings in-app
features.note: Folder browser: back/forward/up, breadcrumb, thumbnails, seekable inline playback

features.name: Delete a recording
features.note: Recycle Bin by default, permanent behind a two-step confirm; applies to a whole selection

features.name: Choose recording quality
features.note: Three presets, persisted in userData; lives in the window’s Settings view

features.name: Floating control bar with recording state
features.note: The app is a floating bar: source, sound, record, timer, pause and stop. Excluded from capture

features.name: Pause and resume a recording
features.note: MediaRecorder pause/resume; the clock excludes paused time

features.name: Mute audio mid-recording
features.note: track.enabled=false records silence; the track is never stopped

features.name: Organise recordings into folders
features.note: Create and delete folders, move by menu or by dragging; one validator for every path (23 refusals asserted)

features.name: Act on several recordings at once
features.note: Ctrl/shift-click and Ctrl+A; move, bin or delete the whole selection from a sticky action bar

features.name: Right-click menus
features.note: A recording, a folder, or the background. Drawn in the renderer so it can list move targets

features.name: Scrub through a saved recording
features.note: Finalized after save (duration + keyframe cues) and served with Range; nothing re-encoded

features.name: Say where a recording went
features.note: A card under the bar: Play and Show in library, both in-app. No window opens by itself

features.name: Settings and Help views
features.note: Quality, microphone and where files go; Help is a key to every button on the bar

features.name: Start and stop from anywhere
features.note: Win+Shift+Z (was Ctrl+Shift+R until 08-04), off by default; the tray icon always works

features.name: Configurable global shortcuts
features.note: Record a region (Win+Shift+Q, on) and start/stop (Win+Shift+Z, off). Keys plus a switch, three keys max; a taken one is reported

features.name: Choose where recordings are saved
features.note: Never moves existing recordings; a missing chosen folder falls back to the default and says so

features.name: A short guided tour of the bar
features.note: Six steps on the live bar: once on a fresh install's first launch, and from Help

features.name: Microsoft Store package (MSIX)
features.note: Needs a Partner Center publisher identity, which only the user can obtain

foundation.name: Build tooling, IPC bridge, strict typing
WebM finalizer (duration + cue index, bytes untouched)
Rename to Capturio + generated multi-size icons
Verification by driving the built app over CDP
